KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

3. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. nene
   C. pana
   D. zito

4. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

5. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   B. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.

6. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

7. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mato
   B. kitoto
   C. mitoto
   D. watoto

8. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

9. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Anga.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain thi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Hili na Haya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Nambari 11-50 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
